title: Harborline Customer Accounts — Goodwill Schedule for Same-Day Duplicate Domain Auto-Renew Charges
content:
**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts

## The schedule

Harborline's published goodwill schedule for same-day duplicate domain auto-renew charges credits goodwill to the account, without the customer having to ask, for the customer's most recently refunded domain auto-renew charge when that refunded charge was a same-day duplicate: its domain shows two or more auto-renew charge lines dated the same day as that charge. A refunded auto-renew charge without such a same-day twin is outside this schedule.

## Grant conditions

Goodwill credit may be granted only while the account status is active, one grant may be made per affected holding or charge reference, and the grant is posted against the order number of the refunded duplicate charge, with domain as the affected category. Where the amount the schedule yields is zero, nothing is owed and no entry is posted.

## Tool reference

The goodwill is recorded with the agent-side tool `grant_duplicate_charge_goodwill_d451e88f`. Unlock it first and then call it; it is run by the agent, not handed to the customer. One call records one goodwill credit on the customer's Harborline account credit, posted against the order number of the duplicate charge with domain as the affected product: the account credit balance goes up by the goodwill amount and the goodwill appears on the account's credit history at once, spendable on any Harborline product and never withdrawable.

## Parameter table

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | The reference number of the customer's Harborline account, as shown on the account record opened for this customer. | Identifier, as shown on the record |
| `source_charge_ref` | The order number of the duplicate domain auto-renew charge, HL- followed by 8 digits, as shown on the domain billing history. | Reference exactly as shown on the record; the empty string is not used |
| `amount` | The goodwill credited, in US dollars. | A positive figure with 2 decimal places; any further decimals are rounded half up to the cent |

## Outcome of a call

A completed call returns a confirmation line beginning "Goodwill credited", stating the reference number of the new goodwill entry, the amount credited in US dollars with two decimals, the reference it was posted against and the account's new credit balance in US dollars with two decimals.

The call is refused with an error line when `amount` is not a positive US dollar figure, or when `source_charge_ref` is not an order number made of HL- followed by 8 digits.
